policy: Extend fixed white/black frame-strip study to ordinary nonlegendary mono-color M21 cards, inheriting historical calibration names. Per-card poses are scan comparisons only. Fit/select/certify bands and thresholds are unchanged. All 206 scans remain visible; red fails known scale/skew tests and is not accepted despite passing real-scan consistency. White/black templates and transforms are byte-identical to the earlier receipt. No renderer geometry, new pigment, live review template or full-card certification is adopted here.

knownPoses.policy: Preselected calibration card per color; known translation, uniform/anisotropic scale, rotation and skew, repeated under strong color/saturation changes. Residual at four frame extremities below 0.3 canonical pixels, accepted independent certification required. This is method validation, not full-set certification.
